{{Top|leg}}
The '''G-2A gunship''' was a model of [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] that was used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. G-2A gunships razed entire [[City/Legends|cities]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] when the Empire conquered it. The [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] company [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] was later given the "honor" of designing the G-2A's successor, the [[GSS-5C Dustmaker]].
